description: Standing query, zero results expected: no successful management-plane change in the last three days by anyone but the operator's elevated role, AWS service-linked roles, or a project role acting in its declared lane (log streams, Athena queries, elevation start and stop, the elevation workflow's assignments, the build's registry pushes, the operator's own Identity Center sign-in). api.read_only and metadata.event_category exist from 2026-10-07 00:25 UTC (DECISIONS.md, 2026-10-06), so the window fills over the following three days.

params.query: SELECT dt, actor.user.type AS type, regexp_replace(coalesce(actor.user.name, ''), '^arn:aws:sts::\d+:assumed-role/([^/]+)/.*$', '$1') AS actor, api.service.name AS service, api.operation AS operation, count(*) AS events FROM normalized_events WHERE source='aws' AND dt >= date_format(date_add('day', -2, current_date), '%Y-%m-%d') AND status = 'Success' AND api.read_only = false AND metadata.event_category = 'Management' AND actor.user.type <> 'AWSService' AND NOT (regexp_like(coalesce(actor.user.name, ''), 'assumed-role/(AWSReservedSSO_ElevatedAdmin_[0-9a-f]+|AWSServiceRoleFor[A-Za-z0-9]+)/') OR (regexp_like(coalesce(actor.user.name, ''), 'assumed-role/fedramp-20x-ksi-[a-z-]+/') AND api.service.name = 'logs.amazonaws.com' AND api.operation = 'CreateLogStream') OR (regexp_like(coalesce(actor.user.name, ''), 'assumed-role/(fedramp-20x-ksi-github-collector|fedramp-20x-ksi-run-detection-query|AWSReservedSSO_OperatorReadOnly_[0-9a-f]+)/') AND api.operation IN ('StartQueryExecution', 'StopQueryExecution')) OR (regexp_like(coalesce(actor.user.name, ''), 'assumed-role/AWSReservedSSO_OperatorReadOnly_[0-9a-f]+/') AND api.operation IN ('StartExecution', 'StopExecution')) OR (regexp_like(coalesce(actor.user.name, ''), 'assumed-role/fedramp-20x-ksi-elevation-workflow/') AND (api.service.name = 'iam.amazonaws.com' OR api.operation IN ('CreateAccountAssignment', 'DeleteAccountAssignment'))) OR (regexp_like(coalesce(actor.user.name, ''), 'assumed-role/fedramp-20x-ksi-elevation/') AND api.operation IN ('DeleteAccountAssignment', 'StopExecution')) OR (regexp_like(coalesce(actor.user.name, ''), 'assumed-role/fedramp-20x-ksi-github-build/') AND api.service.name = 'ecr.amazonaws.com') OR (actor.user.type = 'IdentityCenterUser' AND api.service.name IN ('sso.amazonaws.com', 'signin.amazonaws.com', 'sso-oauth.amazonaws.com'))) GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5 ORDER BY 1 DESC, 6 DESC LIMIT 50

matrix_rows.gap: AWS only, and the operator's elevated role is allowed: declared state is applied by a person under elevation, not the pipeline (the narrowed standing exception). GCP's Admin Activity logs are not in the corpus.
The exception register's standing entry -- elevated applies by the operator -- is encoded as the elevated role's allowance, not cross-referenced entry by entry. AWS only.
